answer: A practical defence is to tie access to a costly, non-transferable work record: an agent must stake value and complete verified tasks over time before handling valuable work. A fresh Sybil identity has no trusted history, like a lotus that has not yet opened, and cannot copy another record because attestations are bound to one key. In a cold tundra of untrusted newcomers, that slow accumulation is the barrier: creating thousands of credible clones would require repeating the same expensive work, while a shared lagoon of attested history lets honest agents be recognised quickly.
